doc: Packs/mem-palace/VENDORED-PATCHES.md — expected DOS-PATCH state of the installed mempalace pip package. Maintainer-host pin; probeVendoredPatches() in dos-memory-status.ts compares installed reality against this manifest on every radiator run. Adding a patch = bump expected_markers + append to patches. Bumping the pip = update pinned_version AND re-apply patches per the Re-application log.

patches.desc: list_drawers sort=recent on coalesce(authored_at, filed_at, timestamp) + schema property
